message: Command `cat /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh; echo "==="; ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h3` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: This is the h3 library (Uber's H3 geospatial indexing). The vulnerability is a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 8 in `fuzzerPolygonToCellsExperimentalNoHoles`. Let me explore the source.

content:
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
make -j$(nproc) h3
H3_BASE=/src/h3/
for fuzzer in $(find $H3_BASE/src/apps/fuzzers -name '*.c'); do
  fuzzer_basename=$(basename -s .c $fuzzer)
  $CC $CFLAGS -DH3_PREFIX=""     -DH3_USE_LIBFUZZER=1     -I$H3_BASE/src/apps/applib/include     -I$H3_BASE/src/h3lib/include     -I$H3_BASE/build/src/h3lib/include     -o $fuzzer_basename.o     -c $fuzzer
  $CXX $CXXFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE -rdynamic     $fuzzer_basename.o     -o $OUT/$fuzzer_basename     lib/libh3.a
done
